blocks.text: National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag revealed on Thursday, November 5, that the pet crematorium in Bacoor, Cavite, allegedly involved in the dumping of dead pets contracted someone from San Jose del Monte, Bulacan to do the cremation.
